banner.description: HWJob is a smart recruitment platform that connects employers and job seekers efficiently. Find the right job, hire the right person — all in one place.

slide1.title: Find Your Dream Job
slide1.desc: Explore thousands of job opportunities that match your skills and interests.

slide2.title: Hire the Right People, Build a Strong Team

resume.title: Complete your profile & add a professional CV
resume.desc: Fully update your personal information, skills and experience to make a strong impression on employers.

badge.title: Collect badges – Upgrade your profile, assert yourself!

streak.title: Check in and receive coins – The more diligent, the richer!
